title: Boosting Software Development with AI: Manage Your Agents
summary: A developer created a visualization tool called the Middle Management Simulator to track and manage multiple AI agents working simultaneously in GitHub Copilot and VS Code. The dashboard displays agent status in real time with animated avatars, helping developers identify blocked agents, monitor progress, and find conversations requiring human input.
key_points: Multiple AI agents working simultaneously create visibility challenges without proper management tools
The Middle Management Simulator uses local Copilot workspace data to animate agent avatars and show real-time status
Visual indicators like raised hands signal when agents have questions needing human attention
The dashboard provides insights into blocked agents, token consumption, and task progress
The tool balances practical functionality with engaging interface design inspired by screensaver concepts

quotes.text: The challenge isn't creating agents anymore. It's managing them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core problem shift in AI-assisted development from agent creation to agent coordination and oversight
